title: UK Unmarried Partner Visa | Unique Visa Services
description: Not married but living together? IAA-regulated help with UK unmarried partner visa applications, including cohabitation evidence.
intro: If you are in a long-term relationship with a British or settled partner but not married, you can apply as an unmarried partner. The key is proving you have lived together in a relationship like a marriage.
eligibility: You have lived together in a relationship akin to marriage for the required period
You both intend to live together permanently in the UK
You meet the financial and English language requirements
documents: Evidence of living at the same address, spread across the whole period
Joint bills, tenancy agreements or bank accounts

faqs.q: What counts as proof we lived together?
faqs.a: Official letters addressed to you both at the same address, spread over the period, are strongest. We review what you have and tell you where the gaps are.
